{{Quotation|game|Although [[the Jade Sea]] more than lives up to its name, the jade that makes up its petrified waves is not necessarily of the best quality. The Jade Quarry has been literally carved from the stretch of seabed that contains the finest and most valuable jade derived from the mineralized bodies of countless sea creatures. Mining in the Jade Quarry is extremely dangerous, as the [[Kurzick]]s and [[Luxon]]s are almost constantly fighting over this valuable resource.}}

[[The Jade Quarry (Luxon)|The Jade Quarry]] is one of the two mission outposts where players can enter The Jade Quarry competitive mission. Players enter alone and are randomly teamed up on the Luxon side.

[[File:GuildWars_Jade_Quarry001.jpg|200px|right]]

== Getting there ==
[[PvP-only character]]s will be [[teleport]]ed here by the [[Luxon Diplomat]] in the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]].

[[Roleplaying character]]s can enter this outpost from [[Jade Flats (Luxon)]]. The Luxon quest [[The Jade Quarry (Luxon quest)|The Jade Quarry]] leads the player here, but is not required to enter. Once the outpost has been unlocked on the map, roleplaying characters can use the Luxon Diplomat as well.
